newsitem.title: UK: KEPIT board picks M&G, Kleinwort proposals.
newsitem.headline: KEPIT board picks M&G, Kleinwort proposals.

text.p: The independent board of the Kleinwort European Privatisation Investment Trust Plc is advising investors that a combination of proposals from fund management group M&G and Kleinwort Benson Investment Management represent best value for sharholders.
